material prices plus the shortage of steel in the domestic markets along with the disruption in the

beyond construction and renewable sector. We have started to see the product line for Defence 
and Aerospace sectors also on the back of recently commissioned specialized tube mill which

half with double-digit volume growth. So, in the absence of export sales and UAE operations, 
these are the two product verticals which are supporting superior volume growth and also the 
margins because of better pricing and better brand value.
